title: Contributor Success Supplykit and Benefits Onramp
author: Aisha Patel
body:
Overview:
This document is a pragmatic, checklist-driven playbook for new contributors (ICs and first-line managers) joining Redwood. It bundles the people-ops "supplykit" (access, benefits activation, essential tooling) with a concise orientation to role expectations and the career ladder so new hires can reach impact in the first 90 days.

Who this is for:
- New individual contributors (engineers, product, design, data) joining Redwood.
- People managers onboarding their new direct reports.
- People-ops and Hiring Managers coordinating role activation and benefit enrollment.

Owners and contact points:
- Primary owner: People Operations (Aisha Patel, people-ops@redwood.com)
- Manager onboarding liaison: Marcus Lee (manager-enablement@redwood.com)
- IT & Access owner: Platform Onboarding (it-onboard@redwood.com)

High-level objectives:
1) Ensure every new hire has access to the tools they need by day 1 (or within 48 hours).
2) Make benefits enrollment and payroll/compensation activation straightforward and auditable.
3) Provide role clarity and the career ladder touchpoints that enable measurable early success.
4) Reduce friction across cross-functional teams by standardizing the first-90 workflow.

Quickstart: Day 0 -> 30 -> 60 -> 90 checklist (manager + contributor):
- Day 0 (pre-boarding):
  1. Offer accepted -> People-ops sends Welcome Packet with required forms and first-week agenda.
  2. IT ticket created by hiring manager (template: /ops/it-onboarding-template) including hardware request and Slack/email account provisioning.
  3. Buddy assigned (peer within team) and calendar invites for orientation scheduled.
- Day 1–7 (activation):
  1. Confirm SSO + company email access.
  2. Complete benefits portal registration (step-by-step below).
  3. Join core channels: #org-all, #team-<teamname>, #onboarding.
  4. First-Week Goals: meet manager for expectations, review role brief, unblock any infra access issues.
- Day 30 (orientation-to-impact):
  1. Contributor presents 1–2 small deliverables or learning outcomes.
  2. Manager checkpoint: review role-specific expectations and first-90 plan.
  3. Confirm access to CI/CD, staging clusters, and internal repos.
- Day 60 (ramp):
  1. Contributor leading a small piece of work with clearly defined owner.
  2. Career ladder baseline assessment completed: manager + contributor agree on target level and growth milestones.
- Day 90 (impact review):
  1. Formal 90-day review: people-ops collects feedback, manager documents outcomes and next objectives.
  2. Confirm benefit elections finalized and reimbursements processed for office/hardware stipends.

Benefits activation (step-by-step):
1. Health & dental enrollment: follow the People-ops Benefits Portal link in the Welcome Packet. Typical steps: create account -> verify identity -> select plan -> confirm dependent coverage. Enrollment window: new hires have 30 days from start date to elect coverage.
2. Retirement plan (401k): opt-in via payroll portal; automatic matching details and vesting are in the Benefits Portal.
3. Commuter/transportation and wellness stipends: request via expenses.redwood.com and tag the expense "onboarding-stipend" within 60 days.
4. Equity grants & RSU paperwork: HR will send grant notice within 7 business days of start; sign and return to equity@redwood.com.
5. Relocation/reimbursement (if applicable): submit receipts to finance@redwood.com with the signed relocation addendum.

Internal tools access matrix (required by role):
| Area | Minimum access day | Typical owner | How to escalate |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| Email & SSO | Day 0 | IT Onboarding | it-onboard@redwood.com |
| Slack | Day 0 | IT / People-ops | it-onboard@redwood.com |
| Code repos (git, monorepo) | Day 2 | Team Eng Leads | repo-admin@redwood.com |
| CI/CD pipelines | Day 5 | Team Infra | infra-eng@redwood.com |
| Staging/Dev cluster | Day 7 | Platform SRE | platform-oncall@redwood.com |
| HR/Payroll portals | Day 1 | People-ops | people-ops@redwood.com |
| Benefits portal | Day 1 | People-ops | benefits@redwood.com |
| Expense & reimbursements | Day 3 | Finance | finance@redwood.com |
| Internal wiki / Confluence | Day 0 | People-ops | confluence-admin@redwood.com |

Access request guidance:
- Standard flow: manager opens the instrumentation IT ticket using the "New Hire Access" template in ServiceDesk. Expectation: approvals from manager + security for any privileged accesses.
- Expedited requests: tag the ticket "expedite" and copy people-ops; IT will triage for business-critical needs and aim for a 24h turnaround.

Role expectations & career ladder primer (IC focus):
- Quick primer: at Redwood we separate impact scope from managerial responsibility. The individual contributor ladder is organized as: Associate IC -> IC -> Senior IC -> Staff -> Principal. Each step is defined by scope (feature -> subsystem -> cross-product), autonomy, and influence.
- Manager responsibilities during ramp: provide a written role brief in the first week, co-author a personalized 90-day success plan, and schedule weekly 1:1s for the first 60 days.
- Career ladder checkpoints (manager + contributor):
  1. Baseline: manager sets expected level and growth focus within 30 days.
  2. Development plan: define 3 measurable milestones correlated to the ladder descriptors.
  3. Evaluation: use existing competency rubric (link in Welcome Packet) at 90 days to recommend next steps.

Manager checklist for onboarding a new hire:
1. Complete the IT Access template within 48 hours of offer acceptance.
2. Schedule weekly checkpoints for first 8 weeks.
3. Assign a peer buddy and ensure introductions to cross-functional partners.
4. Provide a role brief and a prioritized list of the first three objectives.
5. Confirm benefits registration and stipend processing by day 30.

Tooling tips and quick commands:
- Git: clone canonical monorepo and run bootstrap: 
  git clone git@github.com:redwood/monorepo.git && cd monorepo && ./scripts/bootstrap.sh
- Local dev: follow the Dev Readme in /docs/dev-setup.md (run containerized dev for parity): 
  ./tools/dev up --profile minimal
- Access requests: ServiceDesk CLI (for power users): 
  servicedesk create --template "new-hire-access" --fields "name,email,team" --notify people-ops@redwood.com

Learning & ramp resources (curated):
- Engineering: "Redwood Runtime 101" (confluence link in Welcome Packet) and internal perf lab tutorials.
- Product: product-principles.pdf and market-readouts repository.
- Cross-functional onboarding: "Working with GTM" checklist.
- Leadership: Manager Coaching modules (people-ops learning portal).

Audit and compliance notes:
- People-ops retains onboarding artifacts for 7 years per retention policy. All access grants are logged in the IAM audit system.
- Managers are responsible for confirming access revocation on offboarding checklist (see Offboarding Playbook).

Continuous improvement and feedback loop:
- If any step took longer than the expected SLA (SSO 24h, code repo 48h, cluster access 7 days), file a "onboarding-retro" ticket in the People-ops project.
- Quarterly review: people-ops will sample 10% of recent hires for a retro call to identify systemic blockers.

Appendix A — Templates and links (copy these into the Welcome Packet):
- IT Onboarding Template: /ops/it-onboarding-template
- Manager 90-day Plan Template: /people-ops/templates/manager-90-plan.md
- Expense tag for onboarding hardware: onboarding-hw
- Example role brief: /people-ops/examples/role-brief-engineering.md

Appendix B — Escalation matrix (if something is blocking hire activation):
1. People-ops (people-ops@redwood.com) — first contact.
2. IT Onboarding (it-onboard@redwood.com) — access and hardware.
3. Security (sec-ops@redwood.com) — privileged access or audit questions.
4. VP People (vp-people@redwood.com) — unresolved SLA breaches longer than 72 hours.

Document maintenance and versioning:
- Owner will review this playbook annually and after any major changes to benefits or core tooling.
- Change log: 2025-03-18 created by Aisha Patel; 2026-01-12 updated: clarified stipend process and added ServiceDesk CLI tip.

If you have questions or want this packaged as a one-click checklist in the Welcome Packet, contact people-ops@redwood.com.
